name: Auracle Memory
description: Gives the agent memory of your project. Indexes your notes, docs, and plans so the agent can use them when it answers, and remembers key facts across sessions. Runs locally.
author: Auracle

enablement.purpose: Reads your project's notes and docs on this machine so the agent can use them when it answers. Uses your OpenAI key to build the search index.

marketplace.tagline: Local project memory for the agent
